registries.name: Shadcn (Official)
registries.details: Official registry. Fully functional with MCP. Item count dropped from 449 to 403 (likely restructuring).
registries.recommendation: Essential - use as foundation for all projects.

registries.name: Aceternity UI
registries.details: Advanced animation registry. Grew from 91 to 101 items. Fully functional with MCP.
registries.recommendation: Excellent for animation-heavy projects, marketing sites, portfolios.

registries.name: Cult UI
registries.details: Framer Motion components. Grew from 82 to 98 items. Fully functional with MCP.
registries.recommendation: Great for modern interactions and motion design.

registries.name: Kibo UI
registries.details: Extended shadcn functionality. 41 items discovered. Fully functional with MCP.
registries.recommendation: Good for additional utilities not in core shadcn.

registries.name: Kokonut UI
registries.details: Modern UI components. Count dropped from '100+' to 40 (previous count may have been inflated or restructured). Fully functional with MCP.
registries.recommendation: Good for modern components. Vercel OSS.

registries.name: Magic UI
registries.details: Professional design patterns. 207 items discovered. Fully functional with MCP.

registries.name: Retro UI
registries.details: Vintage/retro themed components. 97 items discovered. Fully functional with MCP.
registries.recommendation: Great for themed or nostalgic projects.

registries.name: Animate UI
registries.details: Motion & transitions. 580 items - the LARGEST third-party registry. Fully functional with MCP.
registries.recommendation: Best registry for animations. Massive component library.

registries.name: Dice UI
registries.details: Accessibility-focused components. 239 items discovered. Fully functional with MCP.
registries.recommendation: Excellent for accessibility and inclusive design.

registries.name: Eldora UI
registries.details: Text animations & device mockups. Grew from 87 to 115 items. Domain is eldoraui.site (not .com). Fully functional with MCP.
registries.recommendation: Great for text animations and app showcase mockups.

registries.name: Neobrutalism
registries.details: No registry.json index file. MCP list and search fail. Individual items work via view_items (tested @neobrutalism/accordion). Usable if you know component names.
registries.recommendation: Usable for known components only. Cannot discover new components via MCP.

registries.name: ReUI
registries.details: Domain returns 404 for registry.json AND individual items (tested combobox-group). Was working in 2025-10-26 test. Registry appears to be completely offline.
registries.recommendation: REMOVE from components.json. Registry is dead.

registries.name: Icons Registry
registries.details: Domain returns 404 for registry.json AND individual items (tested activity). Was working in 2025-10-26 test. Registry appears to be completely offline.
registries.recommendation: REMOVE from components.json. Registry is dead.

registries.name: Origin UI
registries.details: Returns HTML instead of JSON. The URL in components.json (originui.com/r/) is wrong. Previous test used https://coss.com/origin/r/{comp}.json which worked. URL may need updating.
registries.recommendation: Fix URL to https://coss.com/origin/r/{name}.json or remove if that also no longer works.

registries.name: AI Elements (Vercel AI SDK)
registries.details: AI-native component library by Vercel. 77 items (30 components + 47 example blocks). Built on shadcn/ui. Components include conversation, message, code-block, prompt-input, artifact, canvas, and more. Registry index at https://registry.ai-sdk.dev/registry.json. Also available via CLI: npx ai-elements@latest add.
registries.recommendation: Excellent for AI/chatbot applications. Official Vercel library.

untestedRegistries.note: These registries were tested in 2025-10-26 via direct URL but are NOT in the current components.json and were NOT retested via MCP.
